Evaluate the agreement rules against the shipped benchmark

Source: R/benchmark.R
benchmark_comparison.Rd

Runs the benchmark evaluation and returns the confusion table beside the three properties the vignette claims for it, each with an explicit pass column: every accept is a true match, every reject a true nonmatch, and every reviewed pair is a true match (the stale-gender family routed to a person rather than deleted).

Usage

benchmark_comparison(data = mysterynpi::ROSTER_BENCHMARK, digits = 3L)

Arguments

data

[data.frame] shaped like [ROSTER_BENCHMARK], with a `truth` column of `"match"` / `"nonmatch"`.

digits

[integer(1)] precision for the reported rates (srr EA4.1).

Value

a list with `table` (decision by truth), `properties` (one row per claimed property, with `pass`), and `rates` (accept/review/reject shares and precision among accepts). Attribute `"all_pass"` is `TRUE` when every property holds.

See also

`vignette("roster-benchmark", package = "mysterynpi")` for the construction of the corpus and the caveats on what it can show.

Examples

b <- benchmark_comparison()
b$properties
#>                              property violations pass
#> 1        every accept is a true match          0 TRUE
#> 2     every reject is a true nonmatch          0 TRUE
#> 3 every reviewed pair is a true match          0 TRUE
